message: On my way home after remedial lessons, I spotted a familiar silhouette in the courtyard.

name: Iori
message: （Momiji...？）
It seemed like Momiji was reading a book.
I hesitated for a moment, wondering if I should call out to her. As I approached, she noticed me.

name: Iori
message: 「My apologies for earlier. Let’s do the training another time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, I know. Don't worry about it.」
Her reply was curt, but she didn’t seem to be in a bad mood.

name: Iori
message: 「Aren't you with Setsugekka？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why would you think I’d be with her after school？」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, Setsugekka is pretty obsessed with Suzakuin Momiji, after all.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I’d go crazy if someone like that stuck to me 24/7.」
Momiji let out a sigh.

name: Momiji
message: 「I just wish she’d leave me alone for a bit~」

name: Iori
message: 「Do you really like being alone that much?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, people are such a hassle.」
The evening breeze gently swayed the leaves of the trees.

name: Iori
message: 「People are a hassle... well, I suppose you’re right. But don't you get lonely being all by yourself？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Doesn’t matter.」

name: Momiji
message: 「When you’re a Suzakuin, all sorts of people come crawling up to you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「People who approach you with a beaming smile, try to entice you with sweet words, and aim to make you their pawn.」

name: Momiji
message: 「People who pry into your business under the guise of pure curiosity, digging for dirt like hyenas.」

name: Momiji
message: 「People who are blatantly power-hungry, looking for a way to assert dominance and finding their purpose in forcing others to submit.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Honestly, all of that is just such a massive pain.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I mean, I really want to just tell them, ‘Yeah, yeah, I can see right through you, you know?’」

name: Momiji
message: 「But since I’m carrying the Suzakuin name, I have to keep a pleasant face on. It’s honestly so exhausting.」
A true genius who grasps everything in an instant. That is the kind of girl Suzakuin Momiji is.

name: Iori
message: 「So, I’m one of those people, then.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, well, I’d say Iori-sensei is on the much better end of the human spectrum.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t think there’s any lie in the fact that you do it for your students. I trust you on that account.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that’s good to hear.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Though, I really can’t stand how your ideology is rooted in sheer willpower~. I’d like a little more logical justification.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ugh... I’ll be careful.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But then again, if you did that, half of Sensei’s charm would vanish. It’s a tough dilemma~」

name: Iori
message: 「So my charm lies in not being logical？」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-well... yeah, I suppose.」
Hmm, I see.

name: Momiji
message: 「A-anyway!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Setting you aside, Sensei, I don’t want to get involved with the kind of people I mentioned before—people who aren’t worth a single cent.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I don’t want to waste my precious time, a part of my life, on people like that. That’s why I prefer being alone.」

name: Iori
message: 「I see...」
The bar for being considered a person worth Momiji’s time is set pretty high.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, Iori-sensei, you surely understand why I went out of my way to tell you all this, right？」
Momiji flashes a testing smile.

name: Iori
message: 「You mean that if someone wants to involve themselves with you, you want them to at least offer something of meaningful value, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh, bingo.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that’s a fair enough argument.」
When you boil human interaction down to pure utility, that’s one way to put it. A relationship based solely on interest, devoid of any emotion.

name: Iori
message: 「...Mind if I ask you one thing?」

name: Iori
message: 「If I were to offer you something, Momiji, would you offer me something meaningful in return？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Nope, I wouldn't.」
She answers with a bright smile right away.

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s why, you see, I have no intention of initiating that kind of connection.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't it rude to steal someone's time when you have no intention of making that time meaningful for them？」
This was a message directed at me, since I had been actively trying to get involved with Momiji.
『If you’re going to get involved with me, provide me with meaningful time. If you can't do that, then I'm better off alone.”――

name: Iori
message: 「...That’s pretty harsh.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, did you decide you don't want to deal with me anymore？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I’m fine.」
It sounds like a very arrogant sentiment, but that’s likely not the case. Surely, she is...

name: Momiji
message: 「Good, then do your best. I have high expectations for you, Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I’ll give it a shot.」

name: Iori
message: 「Sorry for bothering you, see you tomorrow！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Yeah, see you tomorrow.」
